transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you to the clinic today?

I've just been feeling... really down and empty inside for about eight months now, and it's not getting any better. It's gotten to the point where I feel so sad and hollow that I knew I needed to get some help. I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have you felt depressed or down for most days over the past two years, or has this been a more recent episode lasting less than two years?
It hasn't been two years yet. I've been feeling this depressed and down for about eight months now. It's definitely a more recent episode, even though it feels like it has been going on forever.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah, completely. I've stopped doing all my hobbies because nothing brings me any happiness or satisfaction anymore. Everything just feels completely flat and pointless.
Have you also had changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, or concentration during this time?

My appetite has completely vanished, and I've lost a lot of weight over the last several months because I just don't feel like eating. As for my sleep, energy, or concentration, I haven't really noticed any major changes with those.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or felt like life isn't worth living. Even though I feel completely empty, I've never wanted to do anything like that.
Have you ever had a period of several days or longer when you felt unusually energized, needed much less sleep, or were much more talkative or impulsive than usual?
No, I've never had a period like that. I've never felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or been overly talkative or impulsive.
